text:
Vincent Trocheck is 33, on his fourth NHL team, and finding his feet in Utah after 313 games as a Ranger. He has a four-game point streak with three goals in it, including a tying goal against Anaheim, and the season line has climbed to six goals and 15 points in 25 games.

The line is modest. The process behind it isn't. At five on five the Mammoth take 58% of the expected goals with him on, three points better than without him, and he throws his body around (65 hits). His goals trail his chances, six on 7.7 expected, so the scoring should pick up. All Three Zones tracking (Corey Sznajder's) says his offense lives in transition, 53% of his shots off the rush. Evolving-Hockey had his value last season coming mostly from the power play. Our range projects 49 to 72 points. For a Utah team still finding its identity, he's the steady veteran in the middle.
